package.name: zealphp
package.summary: Per-request function overrides for long-running PHP servers
package.description: ext-zealphp intercepts PHP built-in functions (header, session_start, setcookie, etc.) and routes them to user-supplied callbacks. Purpose-built for ZealPHP's coroutine server model — each request gets its own response/session state while legacy PHP code calls the same built-in functions unchanged. Allowlist-only design: 53 functions, no class manipulation, no general-purpose API.
package.notes:
0.3.26 — Stage 8: true-global-scope request include + bucket-stable globals reset: - zealphp_require_global(string $path): mixed — run a file's top-level code against EG(symbol_table) (real globals) even from deep in a coroutine call stack, so bare file-scope vars (and every transitive require_once) bind to $GLOBALS. Lets unmodified require_once apps (WordPress $menu/$submenu/$_wp_submenu_nopriv) render in coroutine-legacy in-process mode. Mirrors zend_execute()'s top-frame path, forcing the global symbol table; Valgrind-clean. - reset_to_parent() is now bucket-stable: value-in-place reset (NEVER zend_hash_del), so a live global-scope frame's INDIRECT CVs into EG(symbol_table) can't dangle across a yield. The proven IS_REF write-through (global $wpdb survives its connect yield) is unchanged. phpt 039 covers the primitive.
0.3.25 — coroutine-legacy per-request state reset (completes the PHP-FPM "fresh process per request" contract for the require_once-legacy class): - zealphp_reset_request_statics(): re-initialise function-local static $x to its template each request (mirrors shutdown_executor's static_variables loop) - zealphp_reset_request_class_statics(): re-initialise class static properties to their template each request via zend_cleanup_internal_class_data (incl. object/DI-container statics; unlocks the static-container tier, e.g. Drupal) - fix: replace the non-exported free_zend_constant() with public ZEND_API calls (was aborting the worker with "undefined symbol: free_zend_constant", exit 127) Mirrors PHP's shutdown_executor(). phpt 38/38. Tested PHP 8.3, 8.4 (ASAN).
